body:
Raised: 2026-10-03 (America/Los_Angeles). **Urgent audit follow-up** on PR #648, exact merge `6c6271af6b0dac49b82eaafb2db4de8b9c4611f2`; original source-profile task #616 is closed. Regional integration remains separate.

Confirmed static finding: `data/regional-review/pacific-natural-earth-source-profiles-20261003/build_audit.py` hard-codes baseline `f592b3d8b72f40036218803d2c70c733112e4d37`, but `build_scope()` reads `data/world-index.json`, indexed location parts and hierarchy from the mutable working tree. Its `dump()` unconditionally replaces the committed scope, source profiles and geometry-comparison JSON. A later checkout can therefore generate changed parent/footprint evidence under the old baseline label. `verify_raw_sources()` checks a version label and subject IDs, but does not verify advertised whole-file hashes of retained shapefile sidecars before rebuilding derived evidence. It is not proof that current evidence is wrong or already lost.

Acceptance:
- Preserve all original #616 retained sources, outputs and source limitations; add a separate superseding reproduction vintage inside this issue's owned directory.
- Read the exact declared immutable Git baseline and original source snapshot. Verify release/hierarchy/scope/actual containing geography parts and source sidecar/census/workbook byte descriptors before computing or writing; record original and new hashes with distinct compression semantics.
- Default operation is read-only --check or exclusive creation at an explicitly new destination. Never silently overwrite old evidence or change the baseline label to current main.
- Verify all eight exact subjects and their complete parent chains. Two runs produce identical bytes; changed baseline/input bytes and attempted overwrite fail before writes. Preserve raw source geometry and source-purpose distinctions; report any changed conclusion only after evidence-backed recalculation.
- Use the versioned evidence/shared reproduction contract and exact-head independent release/source review. No shared hierarchy, identity, geometry, grid, certificate, database import or deployment. New substantive geography questions need separate bounded issues; this task repairs reproduction.

Audit validation: actual merged code inspected; no generator run, binary source rehash, upstream restoration or geographic remeasurement was performed.
